description: Public Sony AI research, news, blog, and publication pages on ai.sony, plus research areas, stories, and the landing page. www.ai.sony redirects off-host and is omitted. People, careers, contact, and legal pages are omitted. Each URL was one bounded GET (12s, 3 redirects, 2000000 bytes). robots.txt allows these paths. The sitemap was XML, not a challenge. A challenge, captcha, HTTP error, non-HTML body, robots disallow, login, store, PDF, or off-host redirect is not stored. Rows keep title, publisher, URL, date, and rights. Page text is not stored. creative_commons_attribution means CC BY alone. creative_commons means CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix of those. A missing date is unknown. This module does not fetch. It is not a belief collector, and runner_wired is false.
